summary: Fix catalogue H1-to-H3 skip without changing card design, words or quick-view labels
evidence: Actual Lighthouse software catalogue accessibility98 identifies heading-order: first product H3 follows page H1 before sidebar H2. Catalogue cards become H2; related cards remain H3 under their H2 section. CSS and quick-view selector accept both tags; real native-package regression covers both contexts.
rollback: Revert only semantic card heading/context selectors. Keep content, URLs, image bytes and unrelated rendering intact.
